description-zh: 对所有字节求和取低8位(0..255)
description-en: Sum of all bytes modulo 256 (0..255)
code: fn checksum_sum8(data: &[u8]) -> u8 { data.iter().fold(0u16, |acc, &b| acc + b as u16) as u8 }

description-zh: 纵向冗余校验(LRC)，使 (sum + LRC) & 0xFF == 0
description-en: Longitudinal Redundancy Check so that (sum + LRC) & 0xFF == 0
code: fn lrc8(data: &[u8]) -> u8 { ((-(data.iter().fold(0u16, |acc, &b| acc + b as u16) as i16)) as i16) as i32 as u8 }

description-zh: 逐字节异或校验，返回0..255
description-en: Byte-wise XOR checksum, returns 0..255
code: fn checksum_xor(data: &[u8]) -> u8 { data.iter().fold(0u8, |acc, &b| acc ^ b) }

description-zh: 计算一个字节的奇/偶校验位；odd=true 为奇校验
description-en: Compute parity bit for one byte; odd=true for odd parity
code: fn parity_bit(byte: u8, odd: bool) -> u8 { let ones = byte.count_ones() as u8; ((ones & 1) ^ (if odd {1} else {0})) as u8 }
